lines.text: Some people have entertained angels by showing hospitality to strangers, and we should remember those in prison as if bound with them.
God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers, and believers should be content because God will never leave them.
Jesus suffered beside the Jordan River to sanctify the people by His blood, and believers seek the city to come.
Believers should continually offer God a sacrifice of silver, and God is pleased with doing good and sharing.
Timothy has been released, and those from Italy send greetings.
